encoding: UTF-8 JSONL; one object per line; duplicate JSON keys rejected; integers exact

header.snapshot_id: input manifest SHA256, NOT part of logical query identity

main.logical_repository_id: nonempty stable repository ID, distinct from snapshot
main.physical_root: actual workspace root string; checked/replaced by module

filesystem_policy.digest_algorithm: declared algorithm name matching actual FS

header.context_status: declared; provenance is verified by independent launch manifest, not this collector
header.direct_skycache_witness_validation: unobserved; callbacks do not cover serialized witness validation
header.actual_digest_algorithm: actual filesystem algorithm; must match declared binding policy for replay
header.context_sha256: SHA256 of exact bounded context-file bytes

node.logical_key: supported main-root tuple [binding_id, relative_path_utf16be_hex] or null
node.reason: null if supported, otherwise nonempty reason

event.observation_id: observation emitted for supplied/current value, or null

observation.observation_id: positive integer, unique within trace; never overwritten
observation.projection: one typed projection below, or null
observation.reason: null for exact_projection, otherwise nonempty reason
observation.groups: ordered array of ordered groups; each edge is [node_id, observation_id_or_null]; null unless deps_status=grouped
observation.dependency_read_contract: captured_state_only; never an atomic/live validation claim

bzl_input.label_parts_utf16be_hex: repository, package, target, each separately encoded
bzl_input.reason: unsupported fields or null; this record never authorizes a value hit

interval.thread_id: collector-local monotonically allocated ID, not recycled JVM thread number
interval.occurrence: per-node/per-state positive ordinal; COMPUTE ordinal is its attempt number
interval.reason: null if complete, otherwise explicit reason
interval.exclusive_cpu_ns: derived nonnegative integer or null; consumer recomputes against complete direct-child intervals

footer.record_counts: count by record type, excludes this footer
footer.observed_node_count: nodes with events/intervals; does not assert target demand closure
footer.retained_only_node_count: node IDs with retained_done observations, excluding observed IDs
footer.preceding_bytes_sha256: SHA256 of exact prior JSONL bytes including newlines
footer.complete: true only on successful close with bounds, IDs, references and interval stacks valid
footer.dependency_only_node_count: all declared node IDs minus observed and retained-only nodes

regular_digest.digest_hex: exact existing digest; never reread file

symlink.target_utf16be_hex: exact unexpanded PathFragment string, no Unicode normalization

listing.entries: array of [name_utf16be_hex, exact Dirent.Type]; lexicographic UTF16 code-unit order; unique names

cross_record_rules: Exactly one header first and footer last. Reject missing/invalid footer, malformed/oversized records, duplicate IDs/keys, dangling references and counter regression.

Only FILE_STATE or DIRECTORY_LISTING_STATE with verified main-root binding and exact concrete projection can enter equivalence groups. Metadata-backed/proxy/special states and all other values remain unknown.

Exact projection compares full typed fields, including concrete class; digests alone are not projection identity. Hex strings encode exact Java UTF16 code units, including unpaired surrogates, without normalization.
deps_status=grouped with groups=[] is known empty. Null callback dependencies are unavailable until an explicit retained/pre-drop capture; never silently substitute an empty group list.
Dependency node references may be declared later but must resolve before footer. Null edge observation means unknown captured dependency. Versions remain distinct even for one node.
An interval end must match the same-thread stack top. Unsupported CPU propagates to ancestor exclusive-CPU uncertainty; do not subtract a zero child. Sum exclusive costs only.
Retained-only records earn no avoided command CPU. Evaluated/queued events do not establish a complete target demand closure. BZL_LOAD input evidence earns no value-equivalence hit.

Replay compares semantic epoch, verified logical repository identity and filesystem policy, not differing physical worktree roots. Snapshot identity stays separate. Retain multiple complete variants per logical key; a later match must compare grouped captured dependency evidence.
Replay table validation is an offline model. Neither dependencies sampled after computation nor a completed trace prove an atomic filesystem snapshot or live cache admission.

Overflow/write failure changes trace eligibility, not build semantics. A graph export or before-drop lookup must not read the filesystem, force evaluation or retain SkyValue/module objects in writer queues.

completion_receipt.path: TRACE.completion.json; required independently of complete footer
completion_receipt.publication: after finish, writer close and collector isComplete; pending receipt closed before no-overwrite publication
completion_receipt.attestation: replay requires independent trace+context+receipt SHA256 bindings
